text.p: These are the leading stories in the Albanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
KOHA JONE
- Newspaper says Prime Minister Bashkim Fino was invited by the United States one day late after harsh criticism of President Sali Berisha.
- Newspaper editorial says the defence minister should resign after an explosion in a military depot killed dozens of people.
- Newspaper editor-in-chief Ben Blushi resigns after differences with the publisher over the structure of the daily.
- International envoy Franz Vranitzky will visit Albania next week to be present when parliament passes a new electoral law. He has also asked for the election date to be set as soon as possible.
- The exact character of the mission of the multinational force in Albania is still unclear.
- Unrest in the country has caused Albania's Savings Bank 250 million leks in damages to its offices. Two of its branches remain closed.
GAZETA SHQIPTARE

- Former central bank governor Kristaq Luniku accuses President Sali Berisha, parliament and the former government of not paying attention to his warnings about the danger of pyramid investment schemes and says he was under pressure to grant bank licenses to the companies running such schemes.
- Prime Minister Bashkim Fino says the government will resign if the new electoral law is not passed.
- Villagers retrieved the bodies of four victims killed in the explosion of an arms depot.
ALBANIA

- Aleksander Meksi, the former Democratic Party Prime Minister, said his government had never offered the Sazan Island to the United States to be used as a a military base, as was claimed by Washignton in a recent press release.

- The paper quotes official sources saying 720 people were killed and about 1,200 injured during the wave of unrest over the past two months. Unofficial sources say there are some 1,000 dead and about 3,000 injured.
RILINDJA DEMOKRATIKE
- Genc Pollo, Democratic Party secretary general, says Fino's warning of resignation if the new electoral law is not passed is immature.
ZERI I POPULLIT
- The newspaper editorial says Berisha should resign because he is unable to change his policies.
- The paper says the interior minister should resign because he has been illegaly armed following a decision by Berisha to arm his supporters to help quell the unrest.
